name: Admin Accounting Income Bulk Settle
description: From the incomes multi-select, the sticky bulk bar keeps the count and adds live “Valor total seleccionado” (sum of selected total_amount) and “Saldo pendiente seleccionado” (sum of pending expected rows). Its [Acciones] menu offers “Liquidar” for one or more eligible company expected incomes with pending balance; an ineligible-only selection leaves the item disabled with its reachable reason, while a mixed selection opens only the eligible rows and reports the excluded count. A collection account is not a settlement prerequisite. The shared basic modal lists selected incomes oldest-first (period_date, id tie-break) with pending and allocation totals, pre-fills the received value from total pending, keeps date, notes and the ProjectApp pocket, and proposes oldest-first allocation; editing an allocation freezes it until “Recalcular reparto”. It shows full/partial/uncovered/excess state live, accepts excess as a single-client saldo a favor, and blocks excess for mixed clients, allocations above pending/value, or an all-zero allocation. Confirmation posts one bulk-settle payload and records one pocket movement with liquid children per allocation; covered rows become Pagado and the last uncovered one remains Parcial. For a single selected income the basic modal additionally exposes “Liquidación con ajustes”; confirming that explicit warning discards the basic draft and opens the existing deductions/reprogramming form, so advanced adjustments are never silently mixed with a multi-payment. A 400 leaves the modal open and a 409 removes exactly stale selected ids. A shared movement remains inspectable from pocket and income detail and deleting that movement reverses the whole abono. A completed income without an issued account displays “Cuenta pendiente de emitir”. The basic modal uses the compact form width.
